info.title: ENA Taxonomy Service API
info.description: REST API for searching and retrieving taxonomic information from the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA). This service provides access to NCBI taxonomy data with additional ENA-specific annotations. Supports searching by taxonomy ID, scientific name, common name, and provides typeahead suggestions for both general search and data submission workflows.

tags.name: Taxonomy Lookup V2
tags.description: Enhanced taxonomy API with HATEOAS support, pagination, and improved response models

post.summary: Search by tax IDs and/or scientific names
post.description: Search taxonomies by providing one or both of taxIds and scientificNames in the JSON body.

get.description: Fetch a single taxonomy record by numeric Tax ID. Provide the tax ID after /tax-id/ in the path. Example: /tax-id/9606

parameters.name: binomialOnly
parameters.description: If true, only binomial taxa are returned

get.description: Provide suggestions suitable for submission forms (submittable taxa). Provide the query after /suggest-for-submission/. Optional limit controls max results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return

parameters.name: binomialOnly
parameters.description: If true, only binomial taxa are returned

parameters.name: pitId
parameters.description: The Point In Time ID. Represents a frozen snapshot of the documents. Leave empty for the first request to create a new snapshot.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The pagination cursor (Base64 encoded sort values). Determines the 'bookmark' where the next page starts. Obtain this from the 'next' or 'prev' links in the response.
